item_name: Rothco Polar Fleece Security Watch Cap
item_short_desc: Stay warm and protected during long shifts in cold weather with Rothco's Polar Fleece Security Watch Cap. Specifically designed for security guards, this durable and lightweight watch cap is made from high-quality polar fleece, offering exceptional warmth without the bulk. The double-layer construction adds an extra layer of insulation, ensuring you stay comfortable even in freezing conditions. The word "Security" is embroidered in bold white lettering on the front, making it clear and professional for any security personnel.
